remarks:
Welcome to 18 Risley Street in Fredonia, NY! Situated on over half an acre, this 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers a great combination of space, convenience, and location.
Inside, the home features a comfortable floor plan with three bedrooms, a full bathroom, and an additional half bath. The basement provides convenient interior access and includes a bonus room offering flexible space for a home office, recreation room, hobby area, or additional storage.
All appliances are included with the sale!
A one-car garage is located underneath the home, while a second detached one-car garage provides even more space for vehicles, tools, lawn equipment, or a workshop.
The spacious property offers over half an acre of land while still being conveniently located within walking distance of downtown Fredonia and SUNY Fredonia. Enjoy easy access to local shops, restaurants, parks, campus activities, and everything the Village of Fredonia has to offer.
With its desirable location, generous lot, two garages, included appliances, and versatile interior space, 18 Risley Street is ready for its next owner.
